zh.title: 五起獨立航空事件彙整：多地出現機上狀況與跑道偏出
zh.summary: 五起事件分別涉及煞車與轉向問題、機上煙霧及跑道偏出等。
body: 以下彙整五起彼此獨立的航空事件，各事件分列如下。
Mesa E175於2026年10月26日在Houston發生煞車與轉向問題。
Gol的波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於2026年10月26日在Maringa發生機上煙霧事件。
United的波音737 MAX 9（ICAO機型代碼B39M）於2026年10月25日在Houston發生起落架安全狀況事件。
Jet2的波音737-800（ICAO機型代碼B738）於2026年10月25日在Birmingham發生短暫偏出跑道事件。
Hong Kong的空中巴士A321neo（ICAO機型代碼A21N）於2026年10月25日飛行途中發生行動電源熱失控。

en.title: Roundup: Five independent aviation incidents reported on October 25–26
en.summary: Five independent reports cover aircraft problems, smoke, a runway excursion and a power-bank event.
body: This roundup covers five independent aviation incidents, presented separately; no relationship among them is stated.
A Mesa E175 had brake and steering problems in Houston on October 26, 2026.
A Gol Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) had smoke on board in Maringa on October 26, 2026.
A United Boeing 737 MAX 9 (ICAO type code B39M) was reported with unsafe gear in Houston on October 25, 2026.
A Jet2 Boeing 737-800 (ICAO type code B738) had a temporary runway excursion in Birmingham on October 25, 2026.
A Hong Kong Airbus A321neo (ICAO type code A21N) had a power-bank thermal runaway en route on October 25, 2026.
